lines.t: Verse 1
I’ve walked through valleys where the silence felt loud,
Questions in my head but no answers around,
Every path I tried only led me astray,
Till I heard a still small voice calling my name.
You were steady when the world was shifting sand,
Held me close when I couldn’t understand,
Even in the dark, You were always near,
Whispering hope that calmed every fear.
Pre-Chorus
So why would I turn from the love I’ve found?
Why would I trade what’s true for what breaks down?
Chorus
What could be better than You?
What lies have more power than Your truth?
What could be better than You?
They say, "Come with us, you have nothin' to fear,"
But I know what they say isn't true.
Because why would I be better off without You?
Lord, Your love is all I wanna feel,
Lord, I know Your love is real.
Verse 2
When my heart was heavy, You carried the load.
Turned my wandering feet back onto the road.
When I turn away, I feel empty and numb,
But with You, I’m no longer lost or undone.
No empty promise could satisfy me,
No fleeting moment could set me free,
Only Your presence fills up my soul,
Only in You am I made whole.
Pre-Chorus
So, I'm not gonna go back to where I've been.
Because what feels right about all this sin?
Chorus
What could be better than You?
What lies have more power than Your truth?
What could be better than You?
They say, "Come with us, you have nothin' to fear,"
But I know what they say isn't true.
Because why would I be better off without You?
Lord, Your love is all I wanna feel,
Lord, I know Your love is real.
Bridge
They make it seem like this world is my true home.
They make it seem like I'm better off alone.
But how could that be true,
When I feel so good with You?
Final Chorus (optional repeat / build)
What could be better than You?
Nothing else can stand beside Your truth,
What could be better than You?
Forever, Lord, I belong to You.
Lord, I know, I feel, it's true,
That nothing is better than You.
